root.label: Bobby Pulido receives Latin Grammy nominations and wins Tejano album awards

events.label: Bobby Pulido receives Latin Grammy nominations and wins Tejano album awards

slots.name: Latin Grammy nominations
slots.sentence: Pulido is best known for Tejano, or Mexican–Spanish folk-style, songs like "Desvelado" and "Se Murió de Amor," and received five nominations for a Latin Grammy Awards, winning Best Tejano Album in 2025 and 2022.
